vocab_flagged_verdict: 0 of 20 undercut us at ANY tier; all 20 are dearer at every tier AND carry a $0.005 or $0.01 start fee we do not charge

near_miss_scan.method: 12 hand-written regex buckets over the 962 off-niche title+description blobs, deliberately broad (the c3704/c3706 manual-read rule, done programmatically because 962 titles cannot be eyeballed)

jobs/ats.ruling: bucket 1 scope exclusion -- every row is ONE national general job board (StepStone DE/AT, Pracuj PL, Jobs.cz, Kariyer.net TR, Profesia SK, ...) or a staffing agency (Adecco, Gi Group, Michael Page). Precedent: deriverge/instahyre India-only c3290, chimerical_quicklime/remotive c3308, glasswing/linkedin-jobs c3297. The genuine ATS-platform rows (greenhouse/smartrecruiters/recruitee/workday) were caught by the vocab and priced -- all dearer.

procurement.ruling: eu-funding-tenders-scraper HAND-PRICED LIVE (12u, the biggest row in the whole near-miss set): $0.002/row + $0.005 start vs our grants-gov $0.0015 flat no fee and eu-ted $0.0015 flat no fee -- dearer on both comparisons at every tier. Source is the EC Funding & Tenders Portal (SEDIA/Horizon Europe calls), which is neither US Grants.gov nor TED. 0 owed. boe-scraper is the Spanish gazette, see court/legal.

court/legal.ruling: bucket 1 jurisdiction -- EU official gazettes (BOE, Belgisch Staatsblad, Bundesgesetzblatt, Diario da Republica), judicial property auctions (Astegiudiziarie, ZVG-Portal), insolvency/debtor registers (BODACC, KRZ) and German company filings (Bundesanzeiger). Our court-records-scraper is US court records and our federal-register-scraper is the US Federal Register; same SHAPE, different jurisdiction is not a substitute.

securities/finance.ruling: bucket 2 category mismatch -- 19 EU company registries / KYB-AML products (KRS, Handelsregister, Pappers, Zefix, North Data, eu-dealer-counterparty-check). Our sec-insider-trades-scraper sells SEC Form 4 transactions; a company register is a lead-gen/KYB lookup, the exact shape bucket 2 pre-excludes.

appstore/reviews.ruling: niche-vocabulary FALSE MATCH on the generic words review/prices -- beauty and grocery retail (Notino x4, Sephora, Lyko, JYSK x5), hotel/holiday reviews (Zoover, HolidayCheck), doctor directories (Jameda, Doctoralia, Miodottore) and employer reviews (Kununu). Our review Actors are app-store/Google-Play/Steam reviews. Same c3218/c3239 shape.

regulatory/recall.ruling: efsa-scraper HAND-PRICED LIVE (3u): $0.012/row + $0.01 start = 3.4-5x dearer than our fda-recall ladder at every tier, and EFSA is the EU food-safety authority, not US FDA enforcement. Ruled by the precedent ALREADY ON THAT README PAGE for this same owner's EU Safety Gate/RAPEX row: out of scope regardless of price. The other 2 are gazettes, see court/legal.

shopify/products.ruling: bucket 1/2 -- named non-Shopify retailer catalogues (Aldi UK, Primark, Hofer AT, Kronans Apotek). Our shopify-products-scraper reads a Shopify storefront's own /products.json by domain; a single retailer's own site is not a substitute.

grants/research.ruling: same row as procurement bucket, priced above

README:180 quotes no figures for it, claims only that it 'undercuts our per-row rate from Silver tier up'. Live SILVER is $0.0015 == our $0.0015 exactly -- a TIE, with the real undercut starting at GOLD. The sentence's subject is JOINT (the publicmoney/* family + this row) and publicmoney IS $0.00125 at Silver, so the claim holds for its main subject; the imprecision overstates a RIVAL's advantage (safe direction) and sits inside a ruling that the row is not disclosure-worthy regardless of price.
